Review the first pairing and drive connection steps
Complete these steps once to pair your phone and open it as a Windows drive.
Connect the phone and computer to the same local network. Open PhoneBridge NG on both devices.
Allow file access, choose the shared folder, then tap “Pair a new computer”. You do not need to start sharing yet.
In Windows, select “Add phone”, choose this phone, enter its 8-digit code, then approve the computer on the phone.
Start sharing on the phone. When Windows finds it, select “Connect”, then “Open files”.
The pairing code is valid only for the current pairing window. Approve only the computer you are pairing now.
